name: Give Gerard a Drink
summary: At the Maclure Vineyards, Gerard Tiller works long days in the fields and needs fresh spring water. He trades apples for water brought by passing travelers.

sections.title: Thirsty Work in the Vineyard Fields
sections.body: Elwynn Forest's farms supply grain, fruit, and vegetables to Stormwind's townsfolk and garrisons. Tending crops under the open sky is hot, demanding work. Gerard Tiller spends long days in the dirt at the Maclure Vineyards, keeping pests away and managing the harvest. With little time to return to town wells, he relies on passing recruits to bring clean spring water so he can keep working.

sections.title: The Economy of Barter
sections.body: Gerard trades provisions instead of coin. Travelers with extra flasks of Refreshing Spring Water can exchange them for fresh apples from the orchard. The kingdom stretches its resources to maintain order and feed its army, so direct barter between smallholders and recruits remains a practical way to get by in rural Elwynn.

faq.answer: Gerard Tiller is a farmer at the Maclure Vineyards in southern Elwynn Forest. He tends the fields and orchards that supply local residents.
Working in the fields under the sun all day is exhausting. Gerard relies on passing travelers for fresh spring water so he can stay hydrated without leaving his chores.

faq.q: Where can Refreshing Spring Water be found?
faq.answer: Food and drink vendors and innkeepers throughout Elwynn Forest commonly sell Refreshing Spring Water. Brother Danil sells it inside Northshire Abbey.
Yes. Gerard keeps working the fields and will trade fresh orchard apples for more bottles of water you can spare.

faq.q: What does Gerard offer in return for the drink?
faq.answer: Gerard trades a Shiny Red Apple for fresh water.
Gerard is outside the barn at the Maclure Vineyards in southern Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: Supporting Elwynn's farmers at places like the Maclure Vineyards helps feed the forest's homesteads and garrisons while the kingdom defends itself.
As a human starting in Northshire, helping neighbors like Gerard Tiller shows the communal spirit that holds Elwynn together.
